Rashi on Nazir 17b:10:1.hebrew: מאי לאו תגלחת דטומאה - דכיון שהזה ושנה וטבל מגלחין אותו, וש"מ דטעון גילוח. והכי משמע: מה נזיר בקבר, ששערו ראוי לתגלחת ז', אין עולין לו מן המנין — ימי חלוטו, שאין שערו ראוי לתגלחת טומאה אלא לתגלחת צרעת, לא כל שכן דאין עולה לו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:10:1.english: What, is it not the shaving of impurity - For once he was sprinkled upon [on the third day], repeated [the sprinkling on the seventh day], and immersed, they shave him; and deduce from this that he requires shaving. And this is what [the baraita] means: Just as [with] a nazir in a cemetery, whose hair is fit for the shaving of the seventh [day], [those days] do not count for him in the tally [of his naziriteship] — [with] the days of his confirmed [leprosy], where his hair is not fit for the shaving of impurity, but rather for the shaving of leprosy, is it not all the more so that [they] do not count for him?

Rashi on Nazir 17b:10:2.hebrew: לא תגלחת דטהרה - שאם לא נכנס לקבר, א"נ נכנס לקבר ונטהר, ואח"כ השלים ימי נזרו — שהוא טעון גילוח לסוף שלשים. דהכי משמע: ששערו ראוי לתגלחת טהרה, שאין מגלח תגלחת טומאה, אלא תגלחת לסוף מיירי. אבל בימי חלוטו, אינו מגלח תגלחת טהרה, אלא תגלחת צרעת לסוף ז':
Rashi on Nazir 17b:10:2.english: No, [it is] the shaving of purity - For if he did not enter a cemetery, or alternatively, he entered a cemetery and was purified, and afterward completed the days of his naziriteship, he requires shaving at the end of thirty [days]. For this is what [the baraita] means: that his hair is fit for the shaving of purity — as he does not shave the shaving of ritual impurity, but rather [the baraita] is dealing with the shaving at the end [of his naziriteship]. However, during the days of his confirmation, he does not shave the shaving of purity, but rather the shaving of leprosy at the end of seven [days].

Rashi on Nazir 17b:1:1.english: Rather - [This explains] what the circumstances of Rava’s inquiry are:

Rashi on Nazir 17b:1:2.hebrew: כגון שנכנס בשידה תיבה ומגדל - בבית הקברות, שמפסיק בינו לבין הטומאה, ונדר בעודו בשידה, שהוא טהור. ואח"כ בא חברו ופרע את המעזיבה שהוא תחתיו, שהיתה השידה מעל ראשו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:1:2.english: Such as where one entered in a chest, box, or cabinet - [Into] a cemetery, which interposes between him and the impurity; and he vowed while still in the chest, when he was pure. And afterward, his fellow came and removed the covering under which he was, for the chest was over his head.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:1.hebrew: ה"ג: כי גמירי שהייה בפנים, אבל אבראי לא - כי גמירי שהייה — כשנטמא בבית המקדש, בפרק ידיעות הטומאה: נטמא בבית המקדש ושהה כדי השתחויה, חייב:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:1.english: This is the reading: When we learned [the tradition of] lingering, [it was] inside, but outside, not - When we learned [the tradition of] lingering, [it was] when one became impure in the Temple, in the chapter [entitled] Yedi’ot HaTumah: [If] one became impure in the Temple and lingered long enough to prostrate [himself], he is liable.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:2.hebrew: אבל אבראי - כגון בבית הקברות, לא בעי שהייה. וכיון שפרע מתחתיו את המעזיבה, אע"ג דלא שהה — חייב:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:2.english: But outside - Such as in a cemetery, it does not require a delay. And once [someone] removed the plaster from beneath him, even though he did not delay, he is liable.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:3.hebrew: או דילמא לא שנא - דהכא והכא בעי' שיעור כדי השתחויה. תיקו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:2:3.english: Or perhaps it is no different - That both here and there, we require the measure of [the time it takes] to prostrate. [The dilemma] shall stand [unresolved].

Rashi on Nazir 17b:3:1.hebrew: בעי רב אשי נזר והוא בבית הקברות טעון גילוח - ביום השביעי שלו, או לא:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:3:1.english: Rav Ashi raises a dilemma: [If] one took a vow of naziriteship while in a cemetery, is he required to shave - On his seventh day [of purification], or not?

Rashi on Nazir 17b:4:1.hebrew: קרבן טומאה הוא דלא מייתי - משום דלא מייתי קרבן אלא מאן דמטמא ליה לנזירותיה, אבל גילוח בעי:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:4:1.english: It is an offering of impurity that he does not bring - Because no one brings an offering except one who defiles his naziriteship, but he is required to shave.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:4:2.hebrew: מה טעם קאמר - אינו מביא קרבן, לפי שאינו מגלח:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:4:2.english: [The Mishnah] is saying, “What is the reason” - He does not bring an offering because he does not shave.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:5:1.english: What, is it not [so that] with regard to shaving, this and that are equal? - That both this [one] and that [one] shave on their seventh [day].

Rashi on Nazir 17b:5:2.hebrew: לא למלקות זה וזה שוין - וכדר' יוחנן לעיל:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:5:2.english: No, with regard to flogging, this and that are equal - And [this is] in accordance with [the view of] Rabbi Yoḥanan above.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:6:1.hebrew: ליתנייה תנא שביעי שלו וכל מילי - דהכי משמע: שביעי שלו עולה לו מן המנין, לפי שאינו מביא קרבן. ומה טעם אינו מביא קרבן? לפי שאינו טעון גילוח טומאה בז'. וזה, אין שביעי שלו עולה, לפי שיש לו לגלח בשביעי ולהקריב קרבן בשמיני, ומאותו יום שמקריב קרבן חל עליו נזירות, כדכתיב (במדבר ו׳:י״א): "וכפר עליו מאשר חטא על הנפש וקדש את ראשו ביום ההוא" — דמשמע: מאותו יום ואילך נזירות דטהרה:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:6:1.english: Let him teach it — he taught "his seventh day" and all matters - For this is what it means: "His seventh day counts for him in the tally" because he does not bring an offering. And what is the reason that he does not bring an offering? Because he does not require shaving of impurity on the seventh [day]. And [as for] this one, his seventh day does not count, because he must shave on the seventh [day] and bring an offering on the eighth [day], and from that day on which he brings an offering, naziriteship takes effect upon him, as it is written (Numbers 6:11): "And he shall make atonement for him, for that he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall sanctify his head on that day," which implies: from that day onward [begins] the naziriteship of purity.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:1.hebrew: ת"ש אין לי - שלא יהו עולין לו מן המנין:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:1.english: Come and hear: I have only - That they should not count for him toward the tally:

Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:2.hebrew: אלא ימי טומאתו - כדכתיב: "והזיר לה' את ימי נזרו", "וקדש את ראשו ביום ההוא", דמשמע: מאותו היום ואילך, שהביא קרבנותיו, יתכפר ויתחיל למנות לימי נזרו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:2.english: Only his days of ritual impurity - As it is written: “And he shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his naziriteship,” [and] “and he shall sanctify his head on that day,” which implies: From that day onward, when he brought his offerings, he attains atonement and begins to count toward the days of his naziriteship.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:3.hebrew: ימי חלוטו מנין - שאם נצטרע בימי נזירותו והוחלט, שלא יהו עולין למנין נזירותו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:3.english: The days of his confirmed [leprosy], from where [is it derived] - That if he was afflicted with leprosy during the days of his naziriteship and was confirmed [as definitely afflicted], they should not count toward the tally of his naziriteship.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:4.hebrew: מה ימי טומאתו מגלח - תגלחת טומאה, ומביא קרבן צפרים:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:4.english: Just as [for] the days of his ritual impurity he shaves - [He performs] the shaving of ritual impurity, and brings an offering of birds.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:5.hebrew: אף ימי חלוטו - דכתיב: "וכבס המטהר את בגדיו וגלח את כל שערו" (ויקרא יד), וכתיב: "וביום השמיני יקח שני כבשים וגו'" — אין עולין לו:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:7:5.english: So too his days of confirmed [leprosy] - As it is written: “And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair” (Leviticus 14:8), and it is written: “And on the eighth day he shall take two he-lambs, etc.” (Leviticus 14:10) — [so too, they] do not count for him.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:8:1.english: For with them he negates the previous [days] - As it is written: “And the previous days shall fall away” (Numbers 6:12).

Rashi on Nazir 17b:8:2.hebrew: תאמר בימי חלוטו שאין מבטל בהן את הקודמין - כגון בנזירות מרובה, כדלקמן בפרק כהן גדול ונזיר (נזיר דף נו:) תנן לה. והואיל ואינו מבטל את הקודמין, יהו עולים לו ימי חלוטו מן המנין:
Rashi on Nazir 17b:8:2.english: Will you say with regard to the days of his confirmation, in which he does not negate the previous [days] - Such as in [the case of] a lengthy naziriteship, as we learn below in the chapter [entitled] Kohen Gadol VeNazir (Nazir 56b). And since he does not negate the previous [days], let the days of his confirmation count for him as part of the tally.

Rashi on Nazir 17b:9:1.hebrew: אמרת ומה נזיר בקבר - נזיר והוא בבית הקברות, ששערו ראוי כו':
Rashi on Nazir 17b:9:1.english: You can say: Just as a nazirite in a grave - [Meaning] a nazirite while he is in a cemetery, whose hair is fit, etc.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:10:1.hebrew: מאי לאו תגלחת דטומאה [לא תגלחת דטהרה] - והכי קאמר: [ומה נזיר בקבר] ששערו ראוי לתגלחת — דשיער שעליו עומד להתגלח לכי ישלים נזירות דטהרה, שהרי אינו מגלח בשביעי — אין עולין; ימי חלוטו, שאין שערו עומד להתגלח לנזירות טהרה, שהרי זקוק לגלח לכשיתרפא מצרעתו — לא כל שכן שאין עולין לו:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:10:1.english: "What, is it not the shaving of impurity? [No, the shaving of purity]" - And this is what [the baraita] is saying: [Just as in the case of a nazirite in a cemetery,] whose hair is fit for shaving — for the hair upon him is designated to be shaved when he completes his naziriteship in purity, since he does not shave on the seventh [day] — [his days] do not count; [as for] his days of confirmed [leprosy], when his hair is not designated to be shaved for naziriteship of purity, since he is required to shave when he is healed from his leprosy — is it not all the more so that they do not count for him?

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:1:1.hebrew: אלא כגון שנכנס בשידה תיבה ומגדל - תחילת כניסתו במקום טמא בהיתר, ולא לקי אכניסה. [אלא] כי מתרין ביה שיצא; בשידה וכו' פרע לו עליו המעזיבה — מספקא ליה: דלמא [לא] בעי שהייה, או דלמא ל"ש, דכל היכא דאירעה טומאה, התם בעי שהייה:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:1:1.english: "Rather, where one entered in a chest, box, or cabinet" - His initial entry into the impure place was permitted, and he does not incur lashes for entering. [Rather], when they warn him to leave — [and in the case of] "in a chest, etc., [and another] removed the roof from above him" — it is a dilemma for him [Rava]: Perhaps tarrying is [not] required [outside the Temple], or perhaps it is no different, for wherever impurity occurred, there tarrying is required.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:1:2.hebrew: ובא חבירו ופרע מעליו המעזיבה - דווקא באונס; דאי מרצונו, אי נמי אם הוא עצמו פרע — כי האי גוונא לא איבעיא לן אי בעי שהייה, דבפ"ב דשבועות (דף יז.) קאמר אהך בעיא דנזיר טמא: "או דילמא באונס גמירי לה שהייה, ל"ש בחוץ ול"ש בפנים":
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:1:2.english: "And another came and removed the covering from above him" - [This was established] specifically [where it occurred] under compulsion; for if [it occurred] with his consent, or alternatively, if he himself removed [it] — in such a case we would not have a dilemma whether he requires tarrying [for liability], as in the second chapter of Shevuot (17a), [the Gemara] says regarding that dilemma of an impure nazirite: “Or perhaps it was learned [as a tradition] that tarrying [applies to impurity contracted through] compulsion, no different outside [the Temple] and no different inside.”

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:3:1.hebrew: הגה"ה: טעון גילוח או אין טעון גילוח - פי': תגלחת דטומאה, ביום שיוצא ויטהר מטומאה. דקרבן ודאי לא בעי, כדתנן במתני' דמיעטיה קרא לקמן; אבל בתגלחת מספקא ליה: אי בעי לגלח בלא קרבן טומאה, או לא — דלא בעי גילוח בלא קרבן. הגה"ה: אבל תגלחת של טהרה ודאי בעי — כשימנה נזירות של טהרה, יגלח ויביא קרבנות טהרה כדין נזיר טהור:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:3:1.english: Gloss: "Is he required to shave or is he not required to shave?" - Explanation: [This refers to] the shaving of impurity on the day that he leaves [the cemetery] and becomes pure from [his] impurity. For an offering he certainly does not require, as we learned in the Mishnah that Scripture excluded him below; but regarding shaving, he is in doubt: Must he shave without an offering of impurity, or not — as he does not require shaving without an offering? Gloss: But the shaving of purity he certainly requires — when he counts [his term of] naziriteship in purity, he shall shave and bring offerings of purity according to the law of a pure nazirite.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:4:1.hebrew: קרבן טומאה הוא דלא מייתי - דמיעטיה קרא לקמן (נזיר דף יח.); הא גלוחי בעי — מדלא קאמר: "ואינו מגלח בשביעי שלו":
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:4:1.english: "It is the offering of impurity that he does not bring" - For Scripture excluded him below (Nazir 18a); but he does require shaving — since [the Mishnah] does not say: "And he does not shave on his seventh [day]."

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:4:2.hebrew: מה טעם קאמר - כלומר: כיון דתנן "אינו מביא", ממילא ידעינן דאינו מגלח, דהא בהא תליא, דהפסוקים קרובים זה לזה. אע"ג דגילוח ביום ז' וקרבן טומאה ביום שמיני, משמע ליה דכיון דאינו מביא קרבן טומאה — דאינו מגלח:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:4:2.english: It is saying: "What is the reason" - That is to say, since we learned [in the Mishnah], "He does not bring," we automatically know that he does not shave, for this is dependent on that, as the verses are adjacent to one another. Even though shaving is on the seventh day and the offering of impurity is on the eighth day, it understood that since he does not bring an offering of impurity, he does not shave.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:5:1.hebrew: הא לתגלחת זה וזה שוין - פירוש: תגלחת דטומאה, מדלא תנא: "זה מגלח וזה אינו מגלח":
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:5:1.english: "That with regard to shaving, this and that are equal" - Explanation: [This refers to] the shaving of ritual impurity, since [the tanna] did not teach: "This one shaves and that one does not shave."

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:6:1.hebrew: תנא שביעי שלו וכל מילי - וכיון דתנא שביעי שלו עולה לו מן המנין, היינו משום שאינו מביא קרבן; וממילא ידעינן דאינו מגלח, כיון דאינו מביא קרבן:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:6:1.english: [The Tanna] taught: "His seventh day", and all matters - And since he taught [that] his seventh day counts for him toward the tally, that is because he does not bring an offering; and automatically we know that he does not shave, since he does not bring an offering.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:7:1.hebrew: ימי טומאה שאין עולין לו מן המנין - פירוש: כשנטמא במת, שהרי אם מנה בטהרה כמה ימים ונטמא, סותר אפילו מנין הראשון, כדכתיב: "והימים הראשונים יפלו", וכ"ש שאותן ימים אין עולין לו, כדכתיב: "וכפר עליו" וגו', והיינו כשיטהר, "וקדש ראשו ביום ההוא" — שיתחיל מנין נזירות טהרה. "ימי חלוטו" — שיושב מחוץ למחנה והחליטו, ומנה מקצת נזירות שקבל עליו קודם שנצטרע, ושוב נרפא וגילח לצרעתו; מנין שיחזור למנות להשלים נזירות למנין שמנה קודם צרעת, וימים שבימי חלוטו לא יעלו לו מן המנין נזירות? אבל ימי הסגרו — דודאי עולין לו, לפי שאין זקוק לגלח כמו מוחלט, ואין [נחשב] לימי טומאה כמו מוחלט:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:7:1.english: "The days of impurity do not count for him as part of the tally" - Explanation: When he became ritually impure through a corpse. For if he counted several days in purity and then became impure, he forfeits even the first tally, as it is written: "And the former days shall be void" (Numbers 6:12); and all the more so do those days [of impurity] not count for him, as it is written: "And he shall make atonement for him..." etc. (Numbers 6:11) — and this means when he becomes purified; "and he shall sanctify his head on that day," meaning that he shall begin the tally of pure naziriteship. "The days of his confirmation" — [this refers to a case] where he sits outside the camp and [the priest] confirmed him [as a leper], and he had counted part of the naziriteship that he had accepted upon himself before he was afflicted with leprosy, and then he was healed and shaved for his leprosy: from where [is it derived] that he resumes counting to complete the naziriteship according to the tally that he counted before the leprosy, and [that] the days that were during the days of his confirmation shall not count for him toward the tally of naziriteship? But the days of his quarantine certainly count for him, since he is not required to shave like a confirmed [leper], and [quarantine] is not [considered] days of impurity like a confirmed [leper].

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:7:2.hebrew: הגה"ה אף ימי חלוטו - שוין לימי טומאתו: דאין עולין לנזירות — ה"נ ימי חלוטו אין עולין לו לנזירותו:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:7:2.english: Gloss: "So too, his days of confirmed [leprosy]" - [They are] equated to his days of ritual impurity: that [just as] they do not count toward naziriteship, so too, his days of confirmed [leprosy] do not count for him toward his naziriteship.

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:8:1.hebrew: לא אם אמרת בימי טומאתו שכן מבטל בו את הימים הקודמים - כדכתיב: "והימים הראשונים יפלו". וא"ת: והיא גופא נילף בהאי דינא, דימי חלוטו יבטלו הקודמים? וי"ל: דאיכא מיעוטא לקמן בפ' שלשה מינין (נזיר דף מד.): "על טומאתו סותר, ואינו סותר על תגלחת" — הכי נמי נימעוט, ונימא דאינו סותר על החלטו:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:8:1.english: "No, if you say [so] with regard to the days of his ritual impurity, in that case he cancels with them the previous days" - As it is written: "But the former days shall be void" (Numbers 6:12). And if you say: But let us derive this itself through this logical deduction, that the days of his confirmed [leprosy] should negate the previous [days]? And one can say: There is an exclusionary phrase below in the chapter [entitled] Sheloshah Minim (Nazir 44a): "For his impurity he negates [the previous days], but he does not negate for shaving" — so too, let us exclude [confirmed leprosy], and say that he does not negate [the previous days] for his confirmed [leprosy].

Tosafot on Nazir 17b:9:1.hebrew: נזיר בקבר ששערו ראוי לתגלחת - ודמי לנזיר, אין עולין לו מן המנין; ימי חלוטו, שאין שערו ראוי לתגלחת ולכך לא דמי [לנזיר] — לא כל שכן שאין עולין לו מן המנין:
Tosafot on Nazir 17b:9:1.english: A nazirite in a cemetery whose hair is fit for shaving - And [so] he resembles a nazirite, [yet the days] do not count toward his tally; [as for] the days of his confirmed [leprosy], where his hair is not fit for shaving and therefore he does not resemble [a nazirite] — is it not all the more so that they should not count toward his tally?
